verdicts.reason: I'd ship neither, but B is less bad. In A, the badges (Limited Edition, Small Batch) are scattered in a ragged cluster about the same size as the CTA, so the CTA gets lost and Small Batch is jammed against the left edge. A's legal text is nearly as big as the body copy, the logo is shrunk to an unreadable size, and the Sunset Sale ribbon crowds the headline. B gives the headline a clear spot with an obvious CTA next to it. Its flaws: the badges and the Sunset Sale ribbon are piled into a cramped column beside the product, the body copy is tiny and a background dot sits on top of it, the legal text is unreadably small, and a broken placeholder image is stuck on the right edge.
